closure.exact_boundary: The exact self-source scalar channel generated by binary support, generator-three colour, half-One coupling, positive Fold parts, quadratic field-energy feedback and every positive iteration depth. The theorem does not claim numerical convergence of every post-Newtonian expansion for every physical source.

decisions.reason: Structural source, half-One coupling and quadratic feedback uniquely force the admissible quarter-One fixed point and depth-independent contraction.
